episode_definition.start: first completed prospective effective month with NG3 state ARMED
episode_definition.same_episode: consecutive completed effective months with state ARMED
episode_definition.close: first completed effective month with state IDLE after an ARMED run
episode_definition.reopen: an ARMED month after at least one completed IDLE effective month starts a new episode
episode_definition.anchor: last trading day of first ARMED effective month

promotion_review.rule: When four complete 252-session prospective episodes exist, only set review_eligible=true. A separate decision record is required for any promotion.
